title: July breaks drought and heat records in France: 'The issue of water is becoming absolutely critical'
subhead: With an average temperature of 24.9°C across the country, July 2026 was the hottest month ever recorded in mainland France since measurements began in the early 20th century. The unprecedented heat was accompanied by an equally exceptional level of soil drought, Météo-France warned.

title: Ceuta crisis: 'Morocco does not just need a new development plan, but a new social contract'
subhead: At the end of July, nearly 50,000 migrants from Morocco entered the Spanish enclave of Ceuta. Rather than a migration crisis, this should be seen as a failure of the pact set up by Morocco's elites, argues economist Jamal Bouoiyour.
